content_html:
TL;DR

Meta AI DMs are rolling out to all Threads users globally. You can chat privately with the AI. In five test countries, Meta AI posts in public feeds but cannot be blocked, only muted.

Meta is rolling out Meta AI to Threads direct messages globally starting today. All users can now share posts, images, links, and videos with Meta AI in a one-on-one conversation, ask follow-up questions, and explore topics privately. The feature mirrors what already exists on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Meta said the move responds to community feedback from users who wanted AI context without sharing conversations publicly.

The more contentious piece remains unresolved. Meta began testing Meta AI in Threads’ public feed in May, initially in Argentina, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, and Singapore. In those markets, Meta AI posts its own content and can be tagged using @meta.ai. Users cannot block the account. They can click “not interested” or mute replies, but the AI’s posts continue to appear in the feed. Meta’s smart glasses are already the subject of a privacy crisis over camera-based surveillance, and embedding an AI account that cannot be blocked into a social feed raises a different but related question: at what point does a feature become a presence that users cannot opt out of?

The DM rollout is the less controversial half. Private AI chat is opt-in by definition, nobody is forced to message Meta AI. The feed presence is the opposite: AI-generated content appears alongside human posts whether users want it or not, and the controls available are limited to reducing its visibility rather than removing it. Meta recently added alerts that notify parents when teens discuss self-harm with Meta AI, acknowledging that the AI’s presence in messaging creates safety responsibilities that a text-only social feed did not have.

Threads has been Meta’s fastest-growing app since its 2023 launch. Adding Meta AI to DMs extends the company’s strategy of putting its AI assistant into every surface where users spend time. The question is whether an AI you can message but cannot block from your feed feels like a feature or an imposition. Meta is betting on feature. The inability to block suggests it is not interested in finding out.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Meta AI DM 正在向全球所有 Threads 用户推出。 您可以与 AI 私下聊天。 在五个测试国家，Meta AI 在公共信息流中发帖，但无法被屏蔽，只能静音。

Meta 从今天开始在全球范围内推出 Meta AI to Threads 直接消息。 所有用户现在都可以在一对一对话中与 Meta AI 分享帖子、图像、链接和视频、提出后续问题并私下探索主题。 该功能反映了 Facebook、Instagram 和 WhatsApp 上已有的功能。 Meta 表示，此举是为了回应用户的社区反馈，这些用户希望在不公开分享对话的情况下获得人工智能背景信息。

更具争议性的部分仍未解决。 Meta 于 5 月份开始在 Threads 的公共源中测试 Meta AI，首先在阿根廷、马来西亚、墨西哥、沙特阿拉伯和新加坡进行测试。 在这些市场中，Meta AI 发布自己的内容，并且可以使用 @meta.ai 进行标记。 用户无法阻止该帐户。 他们可以点击“不感兴趣”或静音回复，但人工智能的帖子继续出现在提要中。 Meta 的智能眼镜已经成为基于摄像头监控的隐私危机的主题，而将无法被阻止的人工智能帐户嵌入到社交信息流中引发了一个不同但相关的问题：什么时候某个功能会成为用户无法选择退出的存在？

DM 的推出是争议较少的一半。 根据定义，私人 AI 聊天是选择加入的，没有人被迫向 Meta AI 发送消息。 提要的存在则相反：无论用户是否愿意，人工智能生成的内容都会与人类帖子一起出现，并且可用的控件仅限于降低其可见性而不是删除它。 Meta 最近添加了警报，当青少年与 Meta AI 讨论自残时，会通知家长，承认人工智能在消息传递中的存在会产生纯文本社交源所没有的安全责任。

自 2023 年推出以来，Threads 一直是 Meta 增长最快的应用程序。 将 Meta AI 添加到 DM 中扩展了该公司将 AI 助手置于用户花费时间的每个表面的战略。 问题是，你可以向你发送消息但无法阻止你的信息流中的人工智能是否感觉像是一项功能或强加的。 Meta 押注于功能。 无法阻止表明它对找出答案不感兴趣。
